FIELDS.NAME: Artful Expressions Gallery
FIELDS.MAILING ADDRESS: 123 Art Lane, Suite 3B, Creative City, CA 90210-1234
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Artful Expressions Gallery, we specialize in curating and displaying a diverse array of artworks from local and international artists. Our operations focus on providing an inviting atmosphere for art enthusiasts while facilitating sales of paintings, sculptures, and mixed media pieces. We consistently host community events and exhibitions that encourage local engagement and promotion of artistry. Our gallery is equipped with robust fire and water protection systems, ensuring the safety of our high-value inventory. We maintain an annually updated, professionally appraised inventory to guarantee accurate valuations for both insurance purposes and sales transactions. Additionally, we uphold strict compliance with local, state, and federal regulations, affirming our commitment to quality and legality in all aspects of our operations. Customer service is a core focus, with regular staff training to enhance visitor experiences and operational efficiency.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 08/15/2023, we experienced a water leak due to a faulty HVAC system that led to minor damage to four paintings and some inventory stock. The total loss incurred is $2,500. Currently, the status is resolved with repairs made and inventory replenished.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade II, UL Listed
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Enhanced security measures including a state-of-the-art alarm system and monitored surveillance cameras to safeguard high-value inventory.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Artful Expressions Gallery does not store, treat, discharge, apply, dispose of, or transport hazardous materials in its operations. Our activities focus solely on the exhibition and sale of art, with strict compliance to safety regulations.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – Artful Expressions Gallery does not sponsor athletic teams as our focus is primarily on supporting the arts and organizing community events centered around art exhibitions and education.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. Our gallery ensures compliance by having a designated personnel who checks the certificates regularly.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – Artful Expressions Gallery has not had any applicants indicted or convicted of any degree of the crime of fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related crime in connection with this or any other property. We maintain strict compliance with legal and ethical standards in our operations.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Artful Expressions Gallery has not had any policy or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior 3 years. All insurance matters have been resolved satisfactorily.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Artful Expressions Gallery does not lease employees to or from other employers; we employ our staff directly to maintain consistency and quality in our services.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Artful Expressions Gallery carries Workers' Compensation insurance to ensure compliance with legal requirements and to protect our employees in the event of a work-related injury or illness.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – Artful Expressions Gallery also operates Artful Artisans Studio, which complements our mission by providing a space for workshops and art classes. This allows us to further engage with the community and support local artists.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Artful Expressions Gallery does not have any other insurance policies with this company at this time. Currently, we hold an active general liability policy for our operations.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Artful Expressions Gallery is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our operations focus solely on the exhibition and sale of artworks.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Artful Expressions Gallery does not rent or loan equipment to others as our operations focus solely on the exhibition and sale of artworks. We prioritize maintaining the integrity of our inventory and services.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Artful Expressions Gallery has not experienced any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien in the past five years, maintaining a stable financial standing throughout this period.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Artful Expressions Gallery does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals, as our operations focus solely on the exhibition and sale of artworks without the use of hazardous materials.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Artful Expressions Gallery does not have any known catastrophe exposure that could pose significant risks to our operations or inventory. We maintain robust safety and compliance measures to mitigate potential threats.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Artful Expressions Gallery has not had any past losses or claims related to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. We maintain strict compliance with legal standards and prioritize a safe and inclusive environment for all.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Artful Expressions Gallery currently has no uncorrected fire code violations, and we maintain compliance with all applicable fire safety regulations to ensure the safety of our operations.
